text.title: At the café
text.subject: Erste lebende Fremdsprache
text.text:
THE CORNER CAFÉ
Fresh coffee and homemade cakes — family-run since 1985

DRINKS
Tea — £1.50
Coffee — £2.00
Hot chocolate — £2.50
Orange juice — £2.50
(All our drinks are also available to take away.)

SNACKS
Cheese sandwich — £3.50
Tomato soup — £4.00   (served with warm bread)
Apple pie — £3.00   — our customers' favourite!
Chocolate cake — £3.50

Open every day, morning till evening · Free Wi-Fi
Thank you, and enjoy your visit!

annotations.label: How much is a cheese sandwich?
You have £4. Can you buy a coffee AND a tomato soup together? Why or why not?
annotations.answer: No: £2.00 + £4.00 = £6.00, and that is more than £4.

annotations.label: Your friend doesn't like sweet things. Which snack would you recommend, and why?
annotations.answer: The cheese sandwich (£3.50) or the tomato soup (£4.00) — they are not sweet, while the apple pie and the chocolate cake are.

annotations.label: You have £6. Write a short note to the waiter: order two things from the menu and write the total.
annotations.answer: Modelltext: „Hello! I would like a coffee and a chocolate cake, please. That is £2.00 + £3.50 = £5.50. Thank you!“ (2 Dinge von der Karte; Summe gezeigt; einfache, weitgehend korrekte Sätze).

annotations.label: Work in pairs. Act out ordering at the café.
annotations.answer: Erwartet: Kund:in bestellt („Can I have…?“, „I'd like…“) + fragt „How much is it?“; Kellner:in nennt den Preis von der Karte (z. B. „That's £4.00, please.“) und reagiert höflich. Summe darf gebildet werden.
roles: You are the customer. Order one drink and one snack from the menu. Ask how much it is, and ask for the bill. Be polite.
You are the waiter. Greet the customer, take their order and tell them the price (use the menu). Be friendly.
